idea-plugin.name: Spring Boot CRUD Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Spring Boot CRUD Generator generates production-ready CRUD layers for Spring Boot applications directly from JPA entities with advanced features and multi-entity support.

🛢️ NEW: Optional database selection (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, H2) with automatic driver injection.

⚡ Smart Dependency Management: Automatically adds required dependencies (JPA, Validation, Swagger, Security, Database drivers) to your project.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.7

  • 🛢️ Feature: Added optional database selection (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, H2)
  • ⚡ Enhancement: Automatic database driver injection based on selection
  • 🧠 Improvement: Smart dependency injection (JPA, Swagger, Security, DB drivers)
  • 🚀 Upgrade: Migrated to IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.x
  • 🚀 Compatibility: Updated for IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+
  • 🔧 Fix: Improved build compatibility and removed upper build restriction

action.description: Generate complete CRUD layer with multi-entity support, Swagger, Pagination, Auditing, Exception Handling, optional JWT Security, database selection (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, H2), and automatic dependency injection
